Odisha launches 46 industrial projects worth over Rs 39,000 crore

Odisha's Chief Minister unveiled 46 industrial projects valued at approximately Rs 39,383 crore. These projects are expected to create 42,512 jobs. The total investment is reported as Rs 39,382 crore by one outlet and Rs 39,383 crore by another.
